q: Transition elements are the metals that exist in the block between Groups II and III that is, they are in Groups 3 to 12 of the Periodic Table.
e: ဤသည် textbook ၏ transition elements definition အတိအကျ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Transition elements are the metals that exist in the block between Groups I and II that is, they are in Groups 3 to 12 of the Periodic Table.
e: Transition elements သည် Groups II နှင့် III ကြားတွင် ရှိသည်၊ Groups I နှင့် II ကြား မဟုတ်။

q: The transition elements are located between Group II of the s-block and Group III of the p-block elements in the Periodic Table.
e: ဤသည် Periodic Table တွင် transition elements ၏ တည်နေရာကို မှန်ကန်စွာ ဖော်ပြသည်။

q: The transition elements are located between Group I of the s-block and Group III of the p-block elements in the Periodic Table.
e: ၎င်းတို့သည် s-block Group II နှင့် p-block Group III ကြားတွင် ရှိသည်။

q: Transition elements are elements that have partially filled d subshells (orbitals) which can give rise to cations with incomplete d subshells (orbitals).
e: ဤသည် text တွင် ပေးသော IUPAC-aligned transition elements definition ဖြစ်သည်။

q: Transition elements are elements that have completely filled d subshells (orbitals) which can give rise to cations with incomplete d subshells (orbitals).
e: Transition elements တွင် partially filled d subshells ရှိရမည်၊ completely filled မဟုတ်။

q: Under this definition, groups 3 to 12 are the transition elements and the f-block lanthanide and actinide series are called the inner transition elements.
e: f-block elements ကို inner transition elements ဟု ခွဲသည်။

q: Under this definition, groups 3 to 12 are the transition elements and the d-block lanthanide and actinide series are called the inner transition elements.
e: Lanthanide နှင့် actinide series သည် f-block တွင် ရှိသည်၊ d-block မဟုတ်။

q: There are mainly three series of transition elements.
e: Textbook သည် 3d, 4d, 5d သုံး series ကို ဖော်ပြသည်။

q: The first series 3d transition elements run from scandium ($_{21}\text{Sc}$) through zinc ($_{30}\text{Zn}$).
e: 3d series သည် atomic numbers 21 မှ 30 အထိ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The first series 3d transition elements run from scandium ($_{21}\text{Sc}$) through copper ($_{29}\text{Cu}$).
e: 3d series သည် zinc ($_{30}\text{Zn}$) အထိ ဖြစ်သည်၊ copper မဟုတ်။

q: The second series 4d transition elements run from yttrium ($_{39}\text{Y}$) through cadmium ($_{48}\text{Cd}$).
e: ဤသည် 4d series ၏ နယ်နိမိတ်များကို မှန်ကန်စွာ သတ်မှတ်သည်။

q: The third series 5d transition elements run from lanthanum ($_{57}\text{La}$) through mercury ($_{80}\text{Hg}$) except 14 elements of lanthanide series from cerium ($_{58}\text{Ce}$) to lutetium ($_{71}\text{Lu}$).
e: 5d series သည် lanthanide elements 14 ခုကို ချန်သည်။

q: The third series 5d transition elements run from lanthanum ($_{57}\text{La}$) through mercury ($_{80}\text{Hg}$) except 14 elements of actinide series from cerium ($_{58}\text{Ce}$) to lutetium ($_{71}\text{Lu}$).
e: Cerium မှ lutetium အထိ ချန်သော elements သည် lanthanide series ဖြစ်သည်၊ actinide မဟုတ်။

q: The transition elements are also called the d-block elements because the d orbitals are filled in these elements.
e: d orbitals ဖြည့်မှုကြောင့် ၎င်းတို့ကို d-block elements ဟု အခြားအမည် ပေးသည်။

q: The transition elements are also called the p-block elements because the d orbitals are filled in these elements.
e: d-block elements ဟု ခေါ်သည်၊ p-block မဟုတ်။

q: The transition elements Zn, Cd, and Hg are sometimes called transition metals, but they do not have this characteristic electronic configuration as defined by the IUPAC, so they really do not belong in this category.
e: Zn, Cd, Hg သည် ground states နှင့် common oxidation states တွင် completely filled d orbitals ရှိသည်။

q: The transition elements Zn, Cd, and Hg are sometimes called transition metals, and they have this characteristic electronic configuration as defined by the IUPAC, so they really belong in this category.
e: IUPAC က သတ်မှတ်သော characteristic partially filled d orbital configuration မရှိ။

q: In the 3d series, there are 10 transition elements.
e: 3d series တွင် Sc မှ Zn အထိ elements 10 ခု ပါသည်။

q: In the 3d series, there are 8 transition elements.
e: 3d series တွင် transition elements 10 ခု ရှိသည်။

q: For the 3d series transition elements, the nuclear charge increases from scandium to copper so that atomic radii show a gradual decrease in their values.
e: Nuclear charge တိုး၍ electrons ကို ပိုနီးအောင် ဆွဲပြီး atomic radii လျော့သည်။

q: For the 3d series transition elements, the nuclear charge increases from scandium to copper so that atomic radii show a gradual increase in their values.
e: Nuclear charge တိုးသောကြောင့် atomic radii သည် တိုးမဟုတ်ဘဲ တဖြည်းဖြည်း လျော့သည်။

q: The decrease in atomic radii occurs because the attraction force between the nucleus and electrons is stronger than the electron-electron repulsion force.
e: Nuclear attraction က electron repulsion ကို ကျော်၍ radius ကျုံ့သည်။

q: The decrease in atomic radii occurs because the attraction force between the nucleus and electrons is weaker than the electron-electron repulsion force.
e: Attraction force သည် electron-electron repulsion ထက် ပိုအားကောင်းသည်။

q: Compare to s- and p-block elements, the decrease in atomic radii is less rapid.
e: d electrons ၏ shielding effect ကြောင့် လျော့မှုသည် s- နှင့် p-blocks ထက် နှေးသည်။

q: Compare to s- and p-block elements, the decrease in atomic radii is more rapid.
e: Atomic radii လျော့မှုသည် s- နှင့် p-block elements ထက် နှေးသည်။

q: All the transition elements in this series have quite similar radii, which accounts for their ability to blend together to form alloys.
e: ဆင်တူသော atomic radii ကြောင့် transition metals သည် crystal lattices တွင် အစားထိုး၍ alloys ဖြစ်သည်။

q: All the transition elements in this series have quite different radii, which accounts for their ability to blend together to form alloys.
e: ဆင်တူသော radii ရှိသောကြောင့် alloys ဖြစ်နိုင်သည်။

q: The first ionisation energies (IE) of scandium to copper increase only slightly as the positive charge on the nucleus (atomic number) increases.
e: ထပ်ထည့်သော d electrons က outer s electrons ကို shield လုပ်၍ IE တိုးမှု အနည်းငယ်သာ ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The first ionisation energies (IE) of scandium to copper decrease significantly as the positive charge on the nucleus (atomic number) increases.
e: First ionisation energies သည် အနည်းငယ် တိုးသည်၊ လျော့မဟုတ်။

q: Towards the end of the series, zinc has the larger atomic size and ionisation energy due to the increasing electron-electron repulsion as the occupancy of the d orbitals is completed.
e: Completely filled 3d orbitals သည် electron repulsion တိုး၍ zinc ၏ size နှင့် IE မြင့်သည်။

q: Towards the end of the series, zinc has the smaller atomic size and ionisation energy due to the increasing electron-electron repulsion as the occupancy of the d orbitals is completed.
e: Electron-electron repulsion ကြောင့် zinc သည် atomic size နှင့် ionisation energy ပိုကြီးသည်။

q: Although the 4s orbital is the outermost orbital, it is slightly lower in energy than the 3d orbitals.
e: Neutral atoms အတွက် 4s သည် energy အနည်းငယ် နိမ့်သောကြောင့် 3d မတိုင်မီ ပြည့်သည်။

q: Although the 4s orbital is the outermost orbital, it is slightly higher in energy than the 3d orbitals.
e: ဖြည့်စဉ်တွင် 4s orbital သည် 3d ထက် energy အနည်းငယ် နိမ့်သည်။

q: In atoms of the transition elements, the 4s orbital is normally filled and the rest of the electrons occupy the 3d orbitals.
e: Electrons သည် lower energy 4s ကို 3d မတိုင်မီ ဖြည့်သည်။

q: The filling of the 3d orbitals generally starts from scandium ($_{21}\text{Sc}$) and continues up to zinc ($_{30}\text{Zn}$), in which the orbital is completely filled.
e: Zinc သည် completely filled 3d subshell ဖြင့် 3d series အဆုံး ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The filling of the 3d orbitals generally obeys Hund's rule, with one electron added to each of the five d orbitals before a second electron is added to any one of them.
e: Hund's rule အရ degenerate orbitals ကို pairing မတိုင်မီ singly occupy ဖြစ်သည်။

q: The filling of the 3d orbitals generally obeys Hund's rule, with two electrons added to each of the five d orbitals before a second electron is added to any one of them.
e: Hund's rule အရ orbital တစ်ခုစီတွင် electron တစ်လုံး ဦးစွာ ထည့်ပြီးမှ ဒုတိယ ထည့်သည်။

q: There are two exceptions to the expected regular filling pattern (half-filled or completely filled orbitals); chromium ($_{24}\text{Cr}$) and copper ($_{29}\text{Cu}$).
e: Cr နှင့် Cu သည် half-filled နှင့် completely filled 3d subshells ရရန် expected pattern မှ ကွဲသည်။

q: There are two exceptions to the expected regular filling pattern (half-filled or completely filled orbitals); chromium ($_{24}\text{Cr}$) and zinc ($_{30}\text{Zn}$).
e: Exceptions သည် chromium နှင့် copper ဖြစ်သည်၊ zinc မဟုတ်။

q: In the case of $_{24}\text{Cr}$, one electron from the 4s shifts to the 3d orbitals to attain a more stable electronic configuration with the half-filled 3d orbitals.
e: Half-filled 3d5 configuration သည် chromium အတွက် extra stability ပေးသည်။

q: In the case of $_{24}\text{Cr}$, one electron from the 3d shifts to the 4s orbitals to attain a more stable electronic configuration with the half-filled 4s orbitals.
e: Electron သည် half-filled 3d subshell ရရန် 4s မှ 3d သို့ ရွေ့သည်၊ 4s မဟုတ်။

q: The electronic configuration of $_{29}\text{Cu}$ is $[\text{Ar}] 4s^1 3d^{10}$, instead of the expected $[\text{Ar}] 4s^2 3d^9$.
e: Copper သည် fully filled 3d subshell ရရန် $4s^1 3d^{10}$ ယူသည်။

q: The electronic configuration of $_{29}\text{Cu}$ is $[\text{Ar}] 4s^2 3d^9$, instead of the expected $[\text{Ar}] 4s^1 3d^{10}$.
e: အမှန် configuration သည် $[\text{Ar}] 4s^1 3d^{10}$ ဖြစ်သည်၊ $4s^2 3d^9$ မဟုတ်။

q: In general, the neutral atoms of most of the transition elements have an essential electronic configuration of $(n-1)d^{1-10}ns^{1-2}$.
e: ဤ general formula သည် transition metals ၏ valence shell configuration ဖြစ်သည်။

q: In general, the neutral atoms of most of the transition elements have an essential electronic configuration of $(n-1)d^{1-10}np^{1-2}$.
e: Outermost electrons သည် ns orbital တွင် ရှိသည်၊ np မဟုတ်။

q: When these metals form ions, the electrons are always removed first from the 4s orbital and then from the 3d orbitals.
e: ဦးစွာ ဖြည့်သော်လည်း 4s electrons သည် outermost ဖြစ်၍ ionization တွင် ဦးစွာ ဖယ်သည်။

q: When these metals form ions, the electrons are always removed first from the 3d orbitals and then from the 4s orbital.
e: Electrons ကို 4s orbital မှ ဦးစွာ ဖယ်သည်၊ 3d မဟုတ်။

q: The electronic configuration of the iron(II) ion ($\text{Fe}^{2+}$) is $[\text{Ar}] 3d^6$, and the electronic configuration of the iron(III) ion ($\text{Fe}^{3+}$) is $[\text{Ar}] 3d^5$.
e: Iron သည် Fe2+ အတွက် 4s electrons နှစ်လုံး ဆုံးပြီး stable half-filled Fe3+ အတွက် 3d တစ်လုံး ဆုံးသည်။

q: The electronic configuration of the iron(II) ion ($\text{Fe}^{2+}$) is $[\text{Ar}] 3d^5$, and the electronic configuration of the iron(III) ion ($\text{Fe}^{3+}$) is $[\text{Ar}] 3d^6$.
e: Fe2+ သည် $3d^6$၊ Fe3+ သည် $3d^5$ ဖြစ်သည်၊ ပြောင်းပြန် မဟုတ်။

q: In general, the ions of transition elements have an electronic configuration of $(n-1)d^{1-10}$.
e: Transition metal ions သည် outermost s electrons ဆုံး၍ valence shell တွင် d electrons သာ ကျန်သည်။

q: The zinc element has completely filled 3d orbitals.
e: Zinc ၏ neutral atom configuration သည် $3d^{10}$ တွင် ဆုံးသည်။

q: When zinc forms an ion, it always loses the 2 outer electrons from 4s to give the electronic configuration of $[\text{Ar}] 3d^{10}$.
e: Zinc သည် $4s^2$ ဆုံး၍ Zn2+ ဖြစ်ပြီး stable $3d^{10}$ core ထိန်းသည်။

q: When zinc forms an ion, it always loses the 2 outer electrons from 3d to give the electronic configuration of $[\text{Ar}] 4s^2$.
e: Zinc သည် ion ဖြစ်ရန် 4s electrons ဆုံးသည်၊ 3d မဟုတ်။

q: Copper is considered a transition element because the $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ion has incomplete 3d orbitals.
e: Neutral Cu တွင် filled 3d ရှိသော်လည်း Cu2+ သည် $3d^9$ ဖြစ်၍ IUPAC definition နှင့် ကိုက်သည်။

q: Copper is considered a transition element because the $\text{Cu}^{2+}$ ion has completely filled 3d orbitals.
e: Cu2+ တွင် incomplete 3d orbitals ($3d^9$) ရှိသောကြောင့် transition element ဖြစ်သည်။
